spec_family.name: Drywall Ceilings — New Construction — Finish Coats
spec_family.description: Finish coats for primed drywall ceilings in new construction. Includes protection, cut-in where applicable, finish application (spray/backroll or roll), sanding between coats, and quality-driven inspection. Assumes priming has been completed under SF_DRYWALL_BARE_NC_PRIME.

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier affects number of inspection and sanding rounds between coats.
Ceiling geometry affects application speed and inspection difficulty.
Jobsite condition affects protection and workflow.
Ceiling sheen selection affects defect visibility.

paintable_items.name: Primed Drywall Ceiling Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Measure ceiling surface area in square feet on surface plane.
paintable_items.notes: Vaulted and tray ceilings should include all planes.

variants.notes: Standard flat ceiling finish; flat sheen minimizes defect visibility.
Matte or higher-visibility ceilings require increased inspection and sanding discipline.

assumptions: Ceilings have been properly primed and accepted under SF_DRYWALL_BARE_NC_PRIME.
Finish system is a standard interior ceiling paint; specialty systems are excluded.
Lighting conditions during inspection may not be final lighting.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.summary: Initial draft ceiling finish spec for new construction; finish coats only, post-prime.
